title: Vernagtferner Glacier Water Level Forecasting
methodology: Time-series regression with climate covariates (linear baseline + quantile LSTM)
blockers: BAdW 2013-2024 5-minute hydro-meteorological record is registration-gated; PANGAEA 10.1594/PANGAEA.829530 daily 2002-2012 slice is the open-access fallback for first model run.
WGMS Fluctuations of Glaciers download requires free academic registration; documented in data/README.md.
MeteoSwiss IDAweb cross-border covariates require registration.
